facts.text: Clear Lake City was named after Clear Lake, which lies south of the Johnson Space Center and, along with Clear Creek, separates Harris County from Galveston County.
The community sits next to NASA’s Johnson Space Center and other aerospace giants like Boeing and Lockheed‑Martin, drawing a high concentration of engineers.
Clear Lake Intermediate earned National Blue Ribbon School status in 1986‑87, a rare honor that recognized its academic excellence among Texas schools.
The Clear Lake Area Collection at UHCL archives documents the social, cultural, political, environmental, and economic history of the region, including original materials from local businesses.
Employers such as NASA, aerospace contractors, and local medical facilities anchor the job market, while small businesses and retail centers strengthen the community.
The Freeman Branch Library, a 42,000‑square‑foot facility administered by Harris County Public Library, was funded in part by the Houston Public Library and Friends of the Freeman Library.
